ctx.x: So anyway, Wilbur Kirk, he was so wonderful, you know, said, "Well, come on, Kenny, try." So there was Harry Edison, who was 17 years old at the time, and when I left to go I took him with me, and his mother said -- he's from Columbus, Ohio. So his mother says, "Kenny, look out for
Harry, because I was a little older than Harry." So I said, "Well, don't worry, Mrs. Edison."
